title: Foundations: Heavy Metal - The Complete Guide
summary: What Heavy Metal is, where it came from, and how its songs work.
body:
Heavy Metal songs: Heavy metal is blues-rock turned up past reason: distorted power chords, wailing vocals, and riffs like iron. Black Sabbath invented it in Birmingham in 1970; the world has been banging its head since.

History: Black Sabbath's Paranoid (1970), Judas Priest, and Iron Maiden (NWOBHM, late 1970s) defined the form. Metallica's Black Album (1991) took it to stadiums; the genre now spans dozens of subgenres.

How the songs work: Heavy Metal favors the keys of E, D, C#, A. Common forms include Riff intro, verse-chorus, twin solo, breakdown; Epic multi-section compositions. Players should master palm-muted gallop rhythms first, then the guitar solo as athletic event. Drop-D and lower; capos need not apply.

title: Paranoid - Heavy Metal Song Study

body:
